scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Algebraic Kuga–Satake correspondences and Hodge conjectures on a K3 quadratic locus” (preprints/Algebraic-Kuga-Satake-correspondences-and-Hodge-conjectures-on-a-K3-quadratic-locus-September-30-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c9fde2b758f25505), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let S be a projective K3 surface. Suppose that, for one rational nonisotropic w ∈ TS, one rational polarization, and one full even-Clifford realization, the tensor of jw(v)(a) = vaw is induced by a cycle in CH2 (S × A2)Q. Then rational HC and rational GHC hold in every degree of every self-power of S.
